sys_script_include.description: This script include is invoked by the Get Swift Data UI Action and Refresh Holdings Data UI Action for it's server side processing. This script include calls Swift completed and swift rejected events as per the inputs it recieved in parameters from UI Action(Get Swift Data UI Action ) and also it updates the swift attribute sync field on the trade table. It also, calls el_custody_detail_position_ondemand event from Task and Trade table on the click of Refresh Holdings Data UI Action.
sys_script_include.name: getSwiftPosDataUIAction
